cacheable.why: Static prefix is the fixed systemPrompt constant (~1668 chars) plus the frontmatter instructions appended on 'create' actions (~303 chars) = ~1971 chars, ~490 tokens at 4 chars/token. This is below the ~1024-token threshold where caching typically pays off, so caching is not expected to be worthwhile despite the prefix being literally static text reused on every call.

latency.why: Response is a StreamingResponse over an SSE event-stream; the frontend reads chunks in a for-await loop and invokes a callback per chunk to update the UI live as the HTML/component is generated, so a person is watching output arrive.

model.why: The model is chosen client-side and sent in the request body (server.py:149 branches on data['model'] starting with 'gpt'); the frontend's persisted default for that selector is 'gpt-3.5-turbo' (modelAtom), which is what a user gets without changing settings. The frontend overrides to gpt-4o-mini only when an image is attached.

task.why: The call takes a system prompt instructing the model to act as a 'TailwindCSS Virtuoso' and generate HTML/UI components from a text description or screenshot (create) or revise existing HTML (refine); output is HTML markup rendered as a UI component, not a classification/extraction label or open-ended chat reply.
